package.name: sonic_ffmaster_bridge
package.description: aimdk-to-Unitree-DDS bridge: lets the parity-validated ffmaster_deploy_onnx_ref binary drive the FF Master unmodified. Robot side (aimdk ROS2 topics) is the hardware-validated sonic_ffmaster_dummy skeleton (bus-free gate, foreign-publisher tripwire, staleness watchdog, damp-on-exit); binary side impersonates a Unitree robot on loopback DDS (rt/lowstate, rt/secondary_imu, rt/lowcmd), following gear_sonic/utils/mujoco_sim/unitree_sdk2py_bridge.py.
